about.title: ℹ️ About · Privacy
about.purpose: A web service that helps SeoulTech international students easily find restaurants around campus that fit their budget, distance and taste. We only use data with a known source; anything unverified is shown as 'No info'.
about.license: Data: Public Data Portal (KOGL), © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
about.limits:
- The list reflects the public data's reference date; some places may have closed or moved since.
- Distances are straight-line; walking times are estimates.
- Prices and hours are shown only where we have Good-Price Store data, web research, field surveys or member reports.
- Ratings and solo/group recommendations come only from reviews left in this app.
about.images: The pictures on place cards are **sample images** showing the type of food, not the place's actual dishes. All of them are illustrations Team 4 drew with Python code (SVG). If the team uploads a real photo of a place, that photo is shown instead.
about.privacy:
- **What we collect:** your Google account ID (stored only as a SHA-256 hash), a nickname you choose, optional nationality, and the reviews, favorites and reports you leave
- **What we do not collect:** email, real name, password, phone number, location
- **Why:** to identify members, save favorites and aggregate reviews
- **How long:** everything is deleted immediately when you delete your account (My page → Delete account)
- **Third parties:** we do not share your data
- **Operated by:** Team 4 student project, Seoul National University of Science and Technology
